scientific_integrity: An analytic complete-itinerary proof determines the sharp four-cycle height and coexistence window. A standalone exact-rational program supports it with twelve representative finite checks, which are not claimed to prove the all-parameter result. No independent mathematical review or authorship is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No classification of other periods, global basins, nonisosceles or nonacute triangles, or alternative tie rules. A published exact three-cycle classification is prior art and not part of the novelty. The full hosted text of that historical result was inaccessible for comparison; the accessible indexed scientific statement was compared. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_scope: Full union of the three triangle supporting lines, isosceles vertices (0,0), (1,0), (1/2,v), \(v>1/2\); primitive periods three and four only; distances perpendicular to lines with fixed-on-tie convention.
title: Golden-ratio period-four cutoff and three-attractor coexistence in a triangle projection map
